body:
# Cloudberry Observatory demo

All people, places, equipment and operating rules in this demo are invented. These notes describe a fictional observatory, not the person using the site.

Start with the [aurora survey](projects/aurora-map.md), [Iris Vale](crew/iris-vale.md), [mirror calibration](observatory/mirror-calibration.md), and [observation window](operations/observation-window.md).
title: Cloudberry Observatory demo

body:
# Iris Vale maintains the telescope

Iris Vale is the fictional telescope caretaker. Iris approves changes to the [Sky Lantern telescope](../observatory/sky-lantern.md) and signs off on [mirror calibration](../observatory/mirror-calibration.md).
title: Iris Vale maintains the telescope

body:
# Pavo manages the signal queue

Pavo is an invented maintenance robot. It checks the [signal buffer](../projects/signal-buffer.md) and prepares the [night report](../operations/night-report.md).
title: Pavo manages the signal queue

body:
# Sky Lantern telescope

Sky Lantern is an imaginary telescope built from blue glass and brass. It sits in the [north dome](../locations/north-dome.md), follows the [observation window](../operations/observation-window.md), and feeds the [aurora survey](../projects/aurora-map.md).
title: Sky Lantern telescope

body:
# Mirror calibration uses violet light

The fictional calibration routine uses a violet reference lamp before each session. [Iris Vale](../crew/iris-vale.md) checks the result before opening the [Sky Lantern telescope](sky-lantern.md).
title: Mirror calibration uses violet light

body:
# Observation window opens at 21:00 UTC

In this invented operating plan, observations run from 21:00 to 03:00 UTC. Start after [mirror calibration](../observatory/mirror-calibration.md). Fog follows the [weather procedure](weather.md).
title: Observation window opens at 21:00 UTC

body:
# Observation window opens at 22:00 UTC

In this invented operating plan, observations run from 22:00 to 03:00 UTC. The later start leaves time for [mirror calibration](../observatory/mirror-calibration.md). Fog follows the [weather procedure](weather.md).
title: Observation window opens at 22:00 UTC

links.reason: The fictional plan moved the start to leave time for mirror calibration.

body:
# Crew rotation uses three stations

The fictional crew rotates between the dome, [beacon house](../locations/beacon-house.md), and report desk. [Pavo](../crew/pavo.md) announces each station change.
title: Crew rotation uses three stations

body:
# Fog pauses outdoor observations

This invented procedure pauses observations when the valley fog reaches the blue marker. The crew keeps the [north dome](../locations/north-dome.md) closed until the marker is visible again.
title: Fog pauses outdoor observations

body:
# Night reports separate readings from guesses

Each fictional report has three sections: readings, guesses, and equipment notes. [Pavo](../crew/pavo.md) attaches the [comet catalog](../projects/comet-catalog.md) before filing it.
title: Night reports separate readings from guesses

body:
# Aurora survey maps the imaginary valley

The Aurora survey draws a made-up map of colored lights above Cloudberry Valley. It uses the [Sky Lantern telescope](../observatory/sky-lantern.md), [Prism Engine](prism-engine.md), and [comet catalog](comet-catalog.md).
title: Aurora survey maps the imaginary valley

body:
# Prism Engine sorts light into five bands

Prism Engine is a fictional instrument that groups incoming light into five named bands. Its [lens cache](lens-cache.md) keeps recent readings, and the [signal buffer](signal-buffer.md) carries the rest.
title: Prism Engine sorts light into five bands

body:
# Invented comet catalog

The demo catalog contains three imaginary comets: Paper Kite, Silver Acorn, and Lantern Tail. Their labels appear in the [aurora survey](aurora-map.md) and [night report](../operations/night-report.md).
title: Invented comet catalog

body:
# North dome has a copper roof

The fictional north dome has a copper roof and room for the [Sky Lantern telescope](../observatory/sky-lantern.md). Use the [weather procedure](../operations/weather.md) before opening it.
title: North dome has a copper roof

body: The invented beacon house stores amber and violet spare lamps. The crew checks them during the three-station rotation.
title: Beacon house stores spare lamps

body:
# Juniper Hale is the night observer

Juniper Hale is the invented user of this demo: the night observer at Cloudberry Observatory. Juniper works the [observation window](../operations/observation-window.md) most weeknights and lives at [Beacon House](../locations/beacon-house.md). See [coffee order](coffee.md), [diet](diet.md) and [Moss](moss-the-cat.md).
title: Juniper Hale is the night observer

body:
# Juniper drinks cardamom coffee

Juniper drinks black coffee with a pinch of cardamom, never sugar. Make it before the [observation window](../operations/observation-window.md) opens, not during.
title: Juniper drinks cardamom coffee

body:
# Juniper is vegetarian

Juniper is vegetarian and allergic to walnuts. When ordering for the crew, check this first. Related: [Juniper Hale](juniper-hale.md).
title: Juniper is vegetarian

body:
# Moss the cat

Juniper has a grey cat named Moss who sleeps in the [North Dome](../locations/north-dome.md) control room. Moss is not allowed near the [Sky Lantern](../observatory/sky-lantern.md) mirror covers.
title: Moss the cat

body:
# Juniper's sister Wren

Wren Hale is Juniper's younger sister, a ferry pilot. Her birthday is 14 March; Juniper sends a star chart every year. Related: [Juniper Hale](juniper-hale.md).
title: Juniper's sister Wren

body:
# Juniper prefers short answers

Juniper wants short answers with the conclusion first, and dislikes bullet lists for anything under three items. Units in metric; times in UTC.
title: Juniper prefers short answers

body:
# Juniper plays cello on cloudy nights

When [weather](../operations/weather.md) closes the dome, Juniper practises cello in the library at [Beacon House](../locations/beacon-house.md). Currently learning a Bach suite.
title: Juniper plays cello on cloudy nights
